messages:
rachel_cs: Opening thread for Helium Edu's private 13B tutoring assistant. Customer asks: COPPA/parental-consent filters for under-13 use, student PII pseudonymization, EU data residency, client-managed HSM keys, content-moderation webhook, and an independent safety/regression pass before Dedicated. They also want a pilot SLA tied to curriculum-mapping accuracy.
owen_se: Compat check complete. Model loads in private mode, int4 quant + fp16 KV cache retained. Artifacts staged at s3://private-artifacts/helium/13b/v1. We left deterministic seeding off for prod but can enable for eval.
prof_jin_helium: To confirm: we require per-session pseudonyms (no raw student identifiers), parental-consent flag for accounts under 13, and an explanation endpoint for suggested curriculum changes. Also need local eval to run in our CI before pilot sign-off.
sam_ml: Draft safety/eval plan: 1) curriculum-mapping accuracy (n=2k items) 2) problem-solution hallucination suite (math/science) 3) content-moderation + pedagogy-safety prompts (n=1k) 4) privacy leakage probes for student identifiers. Proposed pass thresholds: mapping >= 98%, hallucination < 0.5%, privacy leakage ~ 0.0%.
viv_sec: Security notes: HSM connector OK but requires customer-signed connector agreement and a connector VM in their VPC. We'll enable no-token retention and pseudonymization hooks. Need legal to approve parental-consent storage flow. I'll post a checklist.
owen_se: Tenant policy snippet we'll apply for pilot:
```
{"tenant":"helium-edu","deploy_mode":"private","region":"eu-west-1","hsm":true,"no_token_logging":true,"pseudonymize_identifiers":true,"parental_consent_required":true,"fallback":"hosted-eu-13b"}
```
prof_jin_helium: Can you provide a one-command eval runner we can execute in CI? Prefer deterministic seeding and a short report JSON.
sam_ml: Sure. Use this runner against their private endpoint:
```
./helium_eval --endpoint https://private.redwood/helium-13b --suite edu_mapping_suite.json --seed 2026 --out helium_report.json
```
rachel_cs: Renewal note: customer tied first-year commitment to pilot KPI: mapping accuracy >=98% and safety pass. If missed, they'll reduce committed capacity and escalate to AE. Flagging renewal-risk-high in CRM and scheduling AE touchpoint.
deploy-bot: private staging deploy for helium-13b started at 2026-03-22T20:30:10Z  logs: https://deploys.redwood/staging/3601234567
rachel_cs: Closing loop  Viv will post the checklist, Sam will post initial eval numbers, and I'll schedule the enablement + parental-consent walkthrough. Keeping this thread as canonical onboarding tracker and renewal note.
